name: omnilab/chebi
description: Omnilab ChEBI: a chemical entity of biological interest by ChEBI id, InChIKey, CAS number, KEGG id or name - its definition, formula, masses, charge, SMILES, InChI, structure depiction, its ontology (what it is a kind of, its roles, functional parents, conjugates) and its identifiers in CAS, KEGG and the other bases - and a search, through the REST API of ChEBI 2.0 (EMBL-EBI), no key needed.
